summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund S filed an 8-K covering three routine items: unregistered sales of equity securities (69,843 common shares at $24.14 NAV per share, total $1.686M, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S), a regular July 2026 distribution of $0.1667 gross per share (net $0.1493 after fees), and portfolio commentary as of June 30, 2026 (158 companies, ~$248M fair value, 98% first-lien senior secured). No special-situation event—this is a periodic operational update with no acquisition, restructuring, or strategic action. Watch for future NAV adjustments or distribution changes.
